_comment: Source of truth for the mod. Edit this (or the balance UI), then run tools/build.ps1 to regenerate mod/ files + all-language localization + tools/ladder_tiers.txt + the mod-compatible 1836 start + ui/data.js. 'inputs' and 'output_qty' are ACTUAL per-throughput volumes the game uses (the builder emits them directly). 'target_be' is the design break-even goal (informational; the UI's 'natural BE' preset re-solves 'inputs' to hit it). Tier order in each industry's 'tiers' array IS the tier number (1-based) used by the ladder. 'vanilla_pm' is the base-game main PM that this tier replaces; the history converter uses it to map vanilla starting factories onto the right tier building.

research_events._comment: ROADMAP step 2. Industry-driven research events. enabled:false builds the plain techs arm, enabled:true the techs+events arm - which is what makes the arm a CONFIG VARIANT rather than a code flag (user ruling 2026-08-11).
